title: Local AI and OCR
goal: Complete a real OCR vertical slice and give all AI tools a usable readiness/recovery path.
dependencies: Phase 2 has gate.status = passed and all required evidence recorded
preserve: Optional managed LFM runtime and loopback policy
OCR clipboard, capture and 6 MB/type checks
Result invalidation on image changes and safe OCR-to-Translation handoff
implementation: Expose useful setup steps in one place: backend, connection check, available model, test and Save.
Make common readiness and error states actionable across AI tools: missing configuration, starting, server unreachable, missing/incompatible model and timed out.
Keep runtime progress truthful. Managed service may show observable starting, ready or failure states.
Maintain OCR lifecycle for paste and native capture. On change or removal, immediately invalidate previous output. Cancellation preserves the current image and output when appropriate.
Verify OCR to copy and Translation using synthetic text and a real local vision model. Keep retries independent from stale responses.

automated.expected: Loopback policy intact. Both provider request paths use suitable text/image inputs. Invalid or absent image/model yields a helpful error instead of a stale result.
automated.evidence: Exact Windows candidate b79846c7473821eba4129d2c00acf2576670ada2: cargo test --locked -p claude-usage-dashboard --bin claude-usage-dashboard, exit 0, 25/25. Loopback, Ollama/llama.cpp payloads, deterministic precision options, image payload limits, and errors. https://github.com/rua-den/sig4a/actions/runs/45855027019/job/140031026099

automated.expected: Concurrent replacement and removal cannot publish stale text. Cancelled capture, copy, and OCR-to-Translation behaviors match the accepted UI.
automated.evidence: cargo test --locked -p claude-usage-dashboard --test dashboard_ui -- --test-threads=1, exit 0, real WebView2 passed. Includes readiness race, generation guards, model diagnosis and result lifecycle. https://github.com/rua-den/sig4a/actions/runs/45855027019/job/140031026099

automated.run: Use the installed Ollama vision model or equivalent pinned local llama.cpp vision model against a synthetic legible phrase. Record backend, model ID, expected text, observed output, and whether clipboard and translation were checked.
automated.expected: The real app produces expected normalized text for both capture/paste paths and passes it to copy/Translation. Substituted API responses do not satisfy this case.

Native capture recognized Close the door.; different native Ctrl+V bitmap recognized Open the window. Both Copied exactly to the native clipboard; VI results were Đóng cửa. real_ui.steps: Open built dashboard and use a reachable endpoint plus a temporary invalid/unavailable endpoint in sandbox. Select model and check diagnosis, then restore valid test config.
real_ui.expected: Ready and failure states are distinguishable and offer a concrete next step. Entered input survives recovery navigation within the session.
real_ui.evidence: Visible real WebView2 dashboard: unavailable loopback endpoint showed actionable unreachable state; restored server then discovered the model, ran real sample vision Test to Ready, saved sandbox config and preserved unsent Grammar input across route changes. The setup stage is required before OCR proof can proceed. https://github.com/rua-den/sig4a/actions/runs/45855074813/job/140031190498

real_ui.steps: Capture a controlled sample area via the app, recognize it, copy it and send to Dịch. Repeat with a synthetic pasted image.
real_ui.expected: The preview belongs to the image processed. Clipboard/result and translation input contain the current OCR text.
real_ui.evidence: Actual native Windows drag acquired a valid 460×110 PNG; after capture Copy/Translate, actual clipboard bitmap + native Ctrl+V replaced the image/invalidated previous actions. Real model recognized both examples; exact native text clipboard and matching Vietnamese handoff verified. https://github.com/rua-den/sig4a/actions/runs/45855074813/job/140031190498

real_ui.steps: Start OCR, replace or remove the image before completion, then try copy/dịch. Cancel a capture with Esc.
real_ui.expected: Late old output stays inactive. An intentional cancel does not overwrite the current image.
real_ui.evidence: Sent native Escape to the picker after successful pasted OCR; verified the existing image, text and Copy action remained. Removed an image during a real pending request and verified the late result did not return or enable Copy/Translate. https://github.com/rua-den/sig4a/actions/runs/45855074813/job/140031190498

test_notes: Observed prerequisites on this Windows machine: Ollama loopback API and a cached LiquidAI LFM2.5 vision model. Check readiness again at phase start. Use only synthetic input and fixtures.

findings.detail: Initial native translation was inaccurate. Revised generic faithful prompt and explicit temperature 0 restored correct translations on both synthetic fixtures; repeated capture output matched. This is scoped sample evidence, not a general guarantee.
